Read the following text carefully, then answer the question.

The Komodo dragon is the largest living lizard in the world. These amazing reptiles can be found only on a few islands in Indonesia, including Komodo, Rinca, and Flores. Adult Komodo dragons can grow up to three meters long and weigh about 70 kilograms. They have rough, scaly skin, strong legs, and a long, powerful tail that they use for swimming and fighting.

Komodo dragons are carnivores, which means they eat meat. They hunt animals such as deer, pigs, and even water buffalo. These lizards have a very strong sense of smell and can detect their prey from several kilometers away. They also have venomous saliva that helps them weaken their victims before attacking.

Unfortunately, Komodo dragons are endangered animals. Their population has decreased significantly because of habitat loss, illegal hunting, and natural disasters. The Indonesian government has established Komodo National Park to protect these unique creatures and ensure their survival for future generations. However, more efforts are still needed to educate local communities and tourists about the importance of preserving these magnificent animals.

What is the main idea of the first paragraph?
pilihan_jawaban: A. Komodo dragons are the largest lizards found only on certain Indonesian islands
B. Komodo dragons are dangerous animals that eat humans
C. Komodo dragons can swim very well across the ocean
D. Komodo dragons are smaller than most other lizards

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan:
Read the following text carefully, then answer the question.

Ahmad had always been fascinated by airplanes since he was a small boy. Every time he heard the roar of an engine in the sky, he would run outside and look up, dreaming of the day he could fly one himself. His parents noticed his passion and bought him books about aviation and model airplanes to build. They always told him that if he worked hard and studied well, he could become anything he wanted to be.

Throughout his school years, Ahmad excelled in mathematics and science, subjects that are important for aspiring pilots. He joined the school's aeromodelling club and won several regional competitions. When he graduated from high school, he applied to the Indonesian Aviation Academy and was accepted with a scholarship.

Now, as a cadet pilot, Ahmad spends his days studying aviation theory and practicing in flight simulators. Although the training is very demanding and sometimes exhausting, he never complains because he knows that every lesson brings him closer to achieving his childhood dream of becoming a commercial pilot and flying across the beautiful Indonesian archipelago.

What can we infer about Ahmad's parents from the text?
pilihan_jawaban: A. They did not support Ahmad's dream of becoming a pilot
B. They wanted Ahmad to become a doctor instead of a pilot
C. They encouraged Ahmad and believed in his potential
D. They were also professional pilots who inspired their son
